gloss: once only; one-off; just one time

definitions.gloss: once only; just one time; one-off
definitions.explanation: Something that happens only once and will not be repeated. Emphasizes the singularity and finality of the occurrence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一回|いっかい}きりだ。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一回|いっかい}きりしか⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I've only been to that store once.

examples.japanese: {一回|いっかい}きり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧わけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はいかない。
examples.english: I can't afford to miss this one-time chance.

notes:
{一回|いっかい}きり emphasizes that something happens only once and will not be repeated. It conveys finality and often a sense of preciousness.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- As adverb: {一回|いっかい}きりしか⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (I've only been once)
- As noun modifier: {一回|いっかい}きり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出会|であ}い→出会い：03445_deai⟧ (a once-in-a-lifetime encounter)
- As predicate: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一回|いっかい}きりだ (you only live once)

THE SUFFIX きり:
きり means 'only' or 'limited to,' emphasizing a boundary. It attaches to quantities: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧きり (all alone), ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧きり (only once).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧きり: only once (same meaning, slightly more formal)
- ⟦たった→たった：00403_tatta⟧⟦{一回|いっかい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧: just one time (emphasizes smallness of the number)
- ⟦{一回|いっかい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧: only once (neutral, less emphatic)
